candidate.name: Muhammad Rayyan Ahmed
credentials: M.Sc. Data Science (in progress), TU Ilmenau

letter.opening: I am applying for the Working Student position in Market & Data Analytics. Turning data into insights that support corporate management, in a global commercial vehicle group, is the kind of analytics work I want to do alongside my M.Sc. in Data Science.
letter.profile_intro: I am an M.Sc. Data Science student at TU Ilmenau. Before moving to Germany I worked as a Business Analyst at Tapal Tea and in SAP data & analytics consulting at TallyMarks Consulting, building dashboards, data models and SQL-based reporting for business teams.

achievements.impact: I built a Power BI dashboard for the CEO comparing monthly sales against the fiscal-year plan
I prepared and presented SAP Analytics Cloud to a client, who subsequently purchased it
I used SQL analysis, data validation and reconciliation to keep reporting accurate across HR, finance, supply chain and procurement

letter.problems_section: In your team I would prepare data-driven analyses in Excel and Python, build clear reports and presentations in PowerPoint, and support management with well-structured findings.
letter.closing: I am available immediately for up to 20 hours per week and will remain enrolled for well over six months. I am happy to relocate to Munich and would be glad to discuss how I can contribute.
letter.language_closing: I work in English (IELTS 8.0) and am currently learning German (A1).
